create.name: Priti Robyn Ross
create.bio:
Priti Robyn Ross has practised yoga for around thirty-five years and has followed the Kripalu tradition since 1984. She is certified at an advanced level in several styles, among them Kripalu and Prana Yoga, co-founded the Pranotthan Yoga School, and for many years directed 200- and 500-hour teacher trainings at Kripalu, the New York Open Center and elsewhere, earning a reputation as a teacher of teachers. Through Life As Yoga, her New York practice, she has taught group classes, private sessions and workshops for close to three decades.

She calls her current focus soul-care: gentle, practical ways of looking after body, heart and spirit, drawn from yoga, breath, meditation and self-inquiry and offered with warmth and humour. Alongside workshops she works one to one as an intuitive soul coach, gives Tarot readings on Zoom that use the cards as a starting point for reflection, and mentors newly qualified yoga teachers. Her YouTube channel carries short guided meditations on breath and presence, and she leads soul-care retreats in the United States and abroad, including regular programmes at Kripalu. A book, The Resilient Self, is forthcoming.
